source_metadata.title: PSS 680 Editing Fun!
source_metadata.description: I play about and make a nice bass sound on the pss 680, then jam it out on the built in sequencer.

protocol.scope: Source amplitude-decay characterization before measuring new slopes. No engine fit, new rate multiplier, claimed MIDI off, noise, production or UI changes.
protocol.prior_information: Existing WAV segmentation and pitch observations were already inspected for stationary frequency, so these are reused sources with new fixed amplitude windows. The new2024 Jon video was inspected only through captions and image coverage, not audio slopes, before this freeze.

video.title: PSS 680 Editing Fun!
video.acquisition: Ordinary public yt-dlp299+251,1080p60 H264+Opus,112904678byte container; no accounts/cookies/bypass. Analysis WAV only60..78s, stereo float48k, source origin60s.
video.procedure: Captions/frames: selects factory99, stores bank1, changes modulation level, then carrier decay31→21; modulator decay remains0 until later~75s. No full raw voice dump or MIDI wire log. All effect indicators appear unlit in continuous front-panel scene; exact key gates are cropped/not recovered.
video.raw_mapping: Pending independent source/firmware check. Display3/value31 or21 must not silently be equated with only D1R or only D2R.
video.event_selection: Within each fixed range, use10ms centered Hann RMS at5ms hops. Active threshold30dB below range90th-percentile RMS. Bridge below-threshold gaps under60ms. Keep every active segment>=80ms; report cropped edge segments. Active entry is an audio observable, NOT a physical/MIDI on. No pitch/gain/on/off optimization.
video.metadata_eligibility: Entire fit window and additional25ms must precede detected active exit; no fitting shortened remnants. No physical note-off inferred from active exit.

protocol.wav_recipe_scope: Same-name author recipes start voice99: Saw/Chiptune decay0/0, Bass mod24/carrier22; all effects to taste. This association is not an observed raw patch or capture-state guarantee. Gate, routing, processing, per-note edits and compression remain unknown. All3 may share one unit/chain.
protocol.envelope_estimator: Centered50ms Hann-weighted energy RMS,5ms hops, original source rate, no resampling. Regress20log10RMS against source seconds with ordinary least squares in each fixed window. Report slope,R²,max absolute residual,measured dynamic range,clipping and minimum amplitude relative to fixed preceding quiet reference. No target-dependent smoothing/taper/duration search.
protocol.captured_quality_gate: Report as a straight captured-decay interior only if all data finite, slope<0,R²>=.99,max absolute residual<=.5dB,fit drop>=.5dB,no abs PCM sample>=32760/32768 in analysis support,minimum RMS>=10*reference RMS. A pass is NOT proof of a held-key D2 segment.
protocol.quiet_reference: WAVs: same file RMS over[old active entry-.30,entry-.10]s. Video: fixed source[60.0,60.2]s (contains speech and therefore only a conservative non-silent reference, not a certified noise floor). Keep reference failure rather than search another floor.

controls.definition: Known continuous decaying waves over padded context, envelope10**(-slope*time/20). Both fixed-timbre forms use the same amplitude decay. No additive noise or audio file output.
controls.eligibility: Control must recover known slope within1percent for same window/frequency/form/phase; retain all failures. These test amplitude extraction, not hardware or unknown FM envelope behavior.

protocol.interpretation: Compare captured slopes descriptively with current2*2**(rate/4)dB/s only CONDITIONAL on documented raw macro mapping, survived key hold, constant FM timbre and capture transfer. No global3x constant can be adopted. Harmonic/FM evolution, Reverb, noteoff, dynamic capture and edits can all invalidate a carrier interpretation.
forbidden: claiming RMS boundaries are MIDI gates

channel_policy.policy: Before reading any new audio amplitude or slope: original mono WAVs use their sole channel; new video measures arithmetic mid,left,right with identical ranges,selection and gates. Mid is primary,other channels retained diagnostics; no channel chosen by agreement. Quiet reference RMS is the ordinary sample RMS over the fixed interval, not an additional centered window requiring unavailable context.

result.interpretation: Captured straight audio interiors only. No segment boundary is a MIDI gate; raw macro mapping and processing are not recovered; no production timing law adopted.

posthoc_harmonic_protocol.classification: Posthoc diagnostic after RMS slopes known; not new holdout, not selection/adoption gate. Parent explicitly requests SAME16 accepted late Bass windows only.
posthoc_harmonic_protocol.method: 100ms Hann-weighted joint sine/cosine least squares at8 integer harmonics of frozen prior FFTfrequency, plus DC and linear trend; Hann weights bothbasis andsignal. Use EXACTsame81 timestamps per late RMS window. No frequency, phase, window, smoothing or rate fit. ReportH1dB slope, harmonic2..8 energyrelativeH1, weighted residual and conditionnumber. H1time slope is descriptive; no new pass threshold or model adoption.
posthoc_harmonic_protocol.scope: Check whether RMS decay could mainly reflect changing harmonic balance. Does not recover keyoff, held status, dry settings, rawmacro mapping or capturetransfer.

posthoc_harmonic_result.classification: Posthoc diagnostic after RMS slopes known; not new holdout, not selection/adoption gate. Parent explicitly requests SAME16 accepted late Bass windows only.

first_attempt_diagnostic.stage: First Chiptune note fixed reference entry0.02 +[-.30,-.10] exceeds file start. Python assertion stopped run before result output.
first_attempt_diagnostic.correction: Retain same fixed window, fit and unavailable-reference rejection; no floor clipping/replacement, source selection or threshold change.

limits: Audio segment boundaries are not MIDI gates. A straight captured decline is not automatically a held-key D2 envelope.
Same-name recipe association is not an observed raw dump. Front-panel Decay macro mapping is unresolved.
Effects, capture transfer, note-wise edits, processing and shared unit/chain remain unknown for author WAVs.
Posthoc two-group pitch profile and harmonic analysis are diagnostics, not fitted RKS laws or fresh holdouts.
Video has readable macro settings but no recovered gates and zero qualified fits.
No arbitrary rate multiplier, source/native/UI/preset/noise/version/host/Git changes; public media remains ignored and is not bundled.
